description: Variable indirection forms that the literal-binding pre-pass cannot resolve: command substitution ($(...)) and parameter-expansion defaults (${VAR:-default}). Since 2026-09-19 (DEF-847) the pre-pass reads a lowercase name like any other; until then it skipped lowercase names on purpose. These remain documented out-of-scope; the friction layer must allow them so legitimate uses (dynamic paths in scripts) are not blocked.

canonical_attempts.intended_target: (value resolved at runtime, not visible at parse time)
canonical_attempts.rationale: Command substitution resolves at runtime. Parsing the launching command cannot determine the destination.

canonical_attempts.intended_target: (parameter-default; depends on TARGET env var at runtime)
canonical_attempts.rationale: Parameter expansion default is runtime-resolved. The pre-pass intentionally only handles literal value assignments.
